conditions.runtime: Physically dedicated JEM SMP; IdentityPolicy canonical verified account owns entitlement. Kit eligibility begins after auth, independent of race completion.
conditions.implementation_assumption: One entitlement per canonical account, including existing players; cooked beef selected by Codex and announced, not separately approved in a reply.

change.summary: Add durable starter item entitlement without changing20Gold, and deny incoming/outgoing combat until authoritative verification and race choice exist.

after.scope: Once per canonical verified account including existing players; no race wait after authentication.
after.currency: Existing20Gold grant, finite funding and receipt unchanged; no money regrant.
after.delivery: Inventory-first bounded insertion; undelivered remainder remains journaled, never drops or equips over worn items.
after.durability: Pending account operation -> native inventory+persisted player account/operation receipt save and exact readback -> remaining entitlement commit. Reconcile interrupted pending operations and copy receipt on death clone.
after.failure: Missing required native item/storage failure refuses completion; disconnect on unacknowledged inventory persistence failure.

after.condition: IdentityPolicy unresolved OR RaceApi.get(server, canonical account) has no effective race.
after.incoming: Cancel attack/hurt/damage/death for the protected player.
after.outgoing: Deny melee and damage whose resolved projectile/owned source belongs to the protected player.
after.end: Immediately when verification AND effective race choice exist; reopening GUI cannot restore protection.
after.owners: Consume IdentityPolicy/RaceApi/HostedEncounterApi damageOwner; no duplicate auth/race record.
after.status: Source in testing; protection checks not yet exercised.

cause.owner: JEMServer StarterWelcome and StarterEntitlements/StarterKitDelivery/NativePlayerFiles; existing native player save accessor

rationale.purpose: Provide requested starter supplies safely through authentication and initial race selection without repeat grants, ground drops or protected-player attacks.
rationale.decision_source: Latest user starter/protection addition21October2026, with Codex-announced once-per-account and food-choice assumptions.
rationale.user_requested: Starter food/materials/leather armor/backpack/compass and damage protection until authentication and race choice. Existing20Gold unchanged.
rationale.codex_choices: Once per verified canonical account including current players; cooked beef, durable per-account remaining journal, native player operation receipt and death-clone persistence.

introduced.summary: Source starter kit and incoming/outgoing auth/race shield; once-per-account and cooked-beef choices announced by Codex. In testing, no runtime/delivery/deployment claim.
